enemies.name: Armored Cannon Beetle
enemies.flavor:
This migrant lithopod has developed a stronger carapace than its relatives.
- Olimar's Notes

enemies.name: Baldy Long Legs
enemies.flavor:
Not as tasty as it looks. Completely inedible.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Beady Long Legs
enemies.flavor:
Poisonous. Consumption results in prolonged writhing and uncontrollable mirth.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Bloomcap Bloyster
enemies.flavor:
The fatty muscle that controls those undulating motions must be eaten fresh. All that quick movement means the meat toughens quickly.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Bug-Eyed Crawmad
enemies.flavor:
When grilled, serves as an excellent filling for an offbeat po'boy. If you have any left over, add it to a liver paste to deepen the flavor.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Burrowing Snagret
enemies.flavor:
Slice the serpentine torso into thin medallions, skewer on a metal rod with Hocotate onions, and barbecue over an open flame.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Empress Bulblax
enemies.flavor:
For a sophisticated delicacy, make a pâté de foie gras from this massively obese creature's liver and spread it over a sesame cracker.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Goolix
enemies.flavor:
A watery gelatinous membrane protects this creature's nervous system.
- Olimar's Notes

enemies.name: Jumbo Bulborb
enemies.flavor:
It's a large creature, but the meat is tender and flavorful. It's impossible to eat in one sitting, so store some portions for later. Coat the fattier meat in cooking oil and freeze. Leaner cuts should be smoked.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Man-at-Legs
enemies.flavor:
Although the meat is a bit on the metallic side, the oil makes a mouthwatering gravy or lubricative vinaigrette.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Masterhop
enemies.flavor:
Meat can be consumed if first dehydrated with a lot of salt. But the eyeballs and the legs are the best parts.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Pileated Snagret
enemies.flavor:
You haven't lived until you've tasted a mint-braised snagret shank! Or if you're feeling especially saucy, stuff a bird with a can of your favorite savory nectar, throw it on the barbeque, and let the juices mingle to make a mean beverage-canister snagret!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Smoky Progg
enemies.flavor:
Egg tastes best when smoked. The flavor of the belly and the head is pleasantly warming.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Titan Blowhog
enemies.flavor:
Creature too large to easily carve. Bigger is not better in this case.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Waterwraith
enemies.ability: Must be attacked by at least 1 purple
enemies.flavor:
Inedible. Known to cause mass hysteria, followed by leg spasms and internal thunderings.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Anode Dweevil
enemies.ability: Creates an Electricity Generator when it dies

enemies.name: Bulbmin
enemies.ability: Get 5 Bulbmin tokens when it dies

enemies.name: Fiery Dweevil
enemies.ability: Creates a Fire Geyser when it dies

enemies.name: Hydro Dweevil
enemies.ability: Creates a Water Spout when it dies

enemies.name: Munge Dweevil
enemies.ability: Creates a Poison Emitter when it dies

enemies.name: Swooping Snitchbug
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn can't move next turn

enemies.name: Venom Dweevil
enemies.ability: Creates a Poison Emitter when it dies

enemies.name: Volatile Dweevil
enemies.ability: When it attacks it dies and drops nothing

enemies.name: Crusted Rumpup
enemies.flavor:
The tip of the tail tastes almost fruity, with notes of sweet and sour. Pairs well with soft-ripened cheeses.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Emperor Bulblax
enemies.flavor:
To prep the tongue for cooking, marinate in olive oil and chop into cubes. Stir in a pot with carrots, potatoes, and chives, cover, and simmer over low heat for several hours. Accompany this mouthwatering, rustic stew with a hearty roll.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Foolix
enemies.flavor: Gently remove the jellied parts. Add fruit and a sweetener of your choice, then serve as a gelatin dessert.

enemies.name: Giant Breadbug
enemies.ability: Move Boss and Treasure back 1 space
enemies.flavor:
Although cooking this colossal beast yields a mountain of meat, every ounce of it is flavorless. Only suitable for intergalactic all-you-can-eat buffets.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Gildemander
enemies.flavor:
The meat gives off a faint aroma similar to a hot pepper. The flavor itself is subtle and elegant. Chargrill the lantern until blackened, and you've got a nutritional superfood.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Horned Cannon Beetle
enemies.flavor:
Drop into boiling water, and let it cook until the shell turns red. Remove from the pot and peel. Sprinkle the drained meat with rock salt.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Mammoth Snootwhacker
enemies.flavor:
The bitter flavor fades as they grow, replaced by a sweet mellow aroma. Stew the base of the trunk, grill the middle, or smoke the tip. The possibilities are endless!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Mamuta
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn can't move next turn
enemies.flavor:
Inedible. Tastes like chicken.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Antenna Beetle
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn are thrown one lane to the right

enemies.name: Bumbling Snitchbug
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn can't move next turn

enemies.name: Calcified Crushblat
enemies.ability: Must be attacked by at least 1 rock

enemies.name: Miniature Snootwhacker
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn return HOME

enemies.name: Puffy Blowhog
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn return HOME

enemies.name: Skutterchuck
enemies.ability: Must be attacked by at least 1 rock

enemies.name: Withering Blowhog
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn return HOME

enemies.name: Armored Mawdad
enemies.ability: Must be attacked by at least 1 rock
enemies.flavor:
Best enjoyed fresh. If the legs aren't twitching when you put it on the grill, don't bother.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Groovy Long Legs
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn are thrown one lane to the left
enemies.flavor:
This creature is mostly tendon, so it often gets stuck in your teeth. Smells like burnt plastic or possibly metal.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Porquillion
enemies.flavor:
Cut the meat into four even slices. Dip slices into a beaten egg, then dredge in bread crumbs. Fry over low heat.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Raging Long Legs
enemies.flavor:
Neither boiling nor baking can diminish this creature's overpowering musky scent. Only suitable for serving to unpleasant in-laws.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Ranging Bloyster
enemies.flavor:
The gills are best prepared deep-fried in an herb and bread-crumb batter. Also tasty poached and drenched with fine soy sauce.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Segmented Crawbster
enemies.flavor:
Dessert meats are all the rage on Hocotate. When the planet's finest chefs hear about the kind of sorbets, pies, and parfaits you can make with the claw meat on this sweet beast, they'll clamor for every morsel we bring home!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Snowfake Fluttertail
enemies.flavor:
Dice finely or puree to make a meaty sorbet. Add a tiny drizzle of fruit sauce for some punch! Pluck the wings and antennae beforehand to use as a garnish if you want to get fancy.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Titan Dweevil
enemies.ability: Each player places 1 free hazards when it dies
enemies.flavor:
Eaten raw, this predator's luxurious legs are bold and full flavored. What a satisfying crunch!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Vehemoth Phosbat
enemies.ability: Must be attacked by at least 3 yellows
enemies.flavor:
Lightly bread and fry whole. Slather a brioche bun with rémoulade, then top with fried beast and a handful of arugula. Serve with a lemon wedge.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Iceblown Dweevil
enemies.ability: Creates an Ice Vent when it dies

enemies.name: Arctic Cannon Larva
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn return HOME

enemies.name: Arctic Cannon Beetle
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn return HOME
enemies.flavor:
Boil the meaty legs until fully cooked, then drizzle with a generous amount of lemon juice. Once the juice has seeped its way into the muscle fibers, suck the meat out of the shell with one big slurp.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Blizzarding Blowhog
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn can't move next turn
enemies.flavor:
Scrape the interior of its elongated nose with a spoon for a quick dessert of meaty shaved ice. Add a drizzle of sashimi-grade soy sauce to take it up a notch!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Puffstool
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn are thrown one lane to the right
enemies.flavor:
Flip upside down, and cook cap over a charcoal grill, low and slow. Once it starts to sweat, it's ready to eat.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Quaggled Mireclops
enemies.ability: Must be attacked by at least 1 rock
enemies.flavor: A fruit so sweet, it could be a dessert unto itself. Remove and discard peel and core. Slice fruit into small pieces and enjoy!

enemies.name: Sovereign Bulblax
enemies.flavor:
For a light appetizer, pluck the ferns off its back and lightly cook to remove any astringent flavor. The tongue, eyes, lips, meat, and fat are very tasty and can be prepared in a variety of ways. Mature specimens have a more highly developed umami flavor.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Toxstool
enemies.flavor:
Bury underground for about 40 days so the poison can leech out. Its smell will make you gag, but the flavor has notes of chocolate!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Icy Blowhog
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn can't move next turn

enemies.name: Plasm Wraith
enemies.ability: Each player places 2 free hazards when it dies
enemies.flavor:
Despite its refreshing citrus scent, the flavour of this beast is decidedly... dangerous.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Scornet Maestro
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn are thrown one lane to the left
enemies.flavor:
Slice thin, fry until golden brown, and serve when cool. Sprinkle the crumbs on top of a creamy clam chowder to give it a little kick!
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Snowy Blowhog
enemies.ability: Any Pikmin attacked this turn can't move next turn

enemies.name: Moss
enemies.flavor:
Convenient for procuring ingredients. Compact, with a tight turning radius.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Ancient Sirehound
enemies.ability: Each player places 3 free hazards when it dies
enemies.flavor:
The ultimate ride, plush and comfortable. I wish I could bring it home with me.
- Louie's Notes

enemies.name: Sandbelching Meerslug
enemies.flavor:
These are crowd-pleasers! Soak overnight to remove remaining sand. Slice cleaned meat into thick pieces and place on grill. Then apply a generous coating of barbecue sauce and cook until sticky and crispy.
- Louie's Notes
